title: SC05-T2 — the sister (SH07a, SH07b, SH08, SH09a, SH09b, SH10)
line: Can I tell you something? / Two years ago, I felt exactly like that. Same mirror, same thoughts. / And I will tell you what I had to learn the hard way. / It was never your age, Michelle. It was the foundation. / Made for young skin, so on ours it just sits on top and ages us.
motionPlan: Rosa turns Michelle gently by the shoulders to face her and speaks low → Rosa turns Michelle gently by the shoulders to face her and speaks low → Michelle listens, her eyes lifting to Rosa's → Rosa says it slowly, certain, holding Michelle's eyes → Rosa says it slowly, certain, holding Michelle's eyes → Rosa taps her own cheek with two fingers as she says it; Michelle touches her own
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
